sources.name: NHTSA ODI recall flat files (FLAT_RCL.zip, daily bulk download)
sources.owner: US DOT NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation
sources.attribution: Source: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation

sources.notes: Bulk alternative to the recalls API for a weekly refresh across a whole inventory: one download instead of one call per year/make/model. RCL.txt layout documented in the same folder.
